scope: Existing formal earnings_forecast deliveries only; historical records with InfoPublDate < 2026-01-01. No strategy training, backtest, model downloads, new data request, or 2026 feature/outcome read.

combined_pre_2026.coverage_2020_2021: No records in these deliveries; records begin 2022.

entity_mapping.security_master_key: security_id; canonical security_id and symbol, no CompanyCode field
entity_mapping.decision: BLOCKED. Do not join CompanyCode to InnerCode/security_id by numeric coincidence or SEC suffix. Require an explicit provider/competition mapping field and, if IDs can change, effective validity dates.

time_and_revision.InfoPublDate: Present for every loaded pre-2026 row and defines the delivery filter; date-only, no intraday release time.
time_and_revision.InsertTime: Present, but it is not established as first-publication time; many records are later than InfoPublDate.
time_and_revision.ID_JSID: Unique in each extracted historical slice, but no linked previous/superseded version chain is provided; uniqueness is not proof that the file is first-version-only.
time_and_revision.XGRQ: The competition dictionary labels this field as modification date; most historical slice rows have XGRQ in 2026. It cannot be used as the historical signal time or as proof of a 2025-known revision.
time_and_revision.execution_rule_if_data_is_later_approved: Date-only event time must be applied no earlier than the next eligible trading decision after InfoPublDate; never use InsertTime/XGRQ until field semantics and version chronology are formally confirmed.

feasibility_decision.what_it_is: Sparse earnings-forecast event text, not a broad company-news/sentiment corpus.
feasibility_decision.text_availability: ResultStatement and ForcastContent are nonempty in the inspected pre-2026 extracts; ForcastReason is a null-typed empty field. Check the per-delivery character/unique-text distributions above.
feasibility_decision.sample_window: Only 2022-2025: part of the 2020-2023 development window and all of 2024-2025 validation; no 2020-2021 coverage.
feasibility_decision.modeling_gate: Do not train or add features until entity mapping and point-in-time/revision lineage are accepted. Current rows can justify only a bounded feasibility review, not an NLP alpha claim.
feasibility_decision.evaluation_window_status: 2024-2025 has already been used for prior strategy comparisons and candidate selection; any new NLP result on it is exploratory, not an untouched final out-of-sample test. 2026 remains sealed and may be opened once only after a fully frozen candidate and data/PIT gates pass.

minimum_missing_inputs: Authoritative CompanyCode-to-symbol/security_id mapping that covers the delivered rows, with temporal validity or evidence identifiers are immutable.
First publication and revision lineage (stable event ID, version/supersedes relation, publication timestamp or conservative date convention, and field semantics for InsertTime/XGRQ).
A decision on whether sparse forecast text is the intended NLP scope; it cannot stand in for general news sentiment.
smallest_valid_next_step_after_gate: Once mapping and version lineage are accepted, first build a linked event-to-stock-date table and re-evaluate usable sample counts. If sufficient, freeze one text-only baseline (e.g. word/character TF-IDF or fixed dictionary features) with vectorizer/feature selection fit only inside each training fold; signal at the next eligible trading decision after publication date. Keep unavailable pre-2022 rows genuinely missing. Treat 2024-2025 comparisons as exploratory because that period has already been used for strategy selection; reserve 2026 for the single final evaluation only after the candidate and account inputs are frozen and the PIT gate passes. A modern pretrained encoder is not historically available merely because it can be applied retrospectively.
